title: Helium browser — UI update teaser

secondary_motion: anticipation shrink (~19%) before the zoom-through, motion blur on the logo spin, ~2% overshoot; no bounce
color: one brand blue with soft white light gradients, then near-white UI; colorfulness 54 comes from the single saturated blue
typography: small clean sans wordmark and 'Update' line; the only play is 'UI' letters closing into a boxed icon
shape_language: precise UI chrome and a geometric asterisk mark, softened by blurred light blobs

signature: Brand-blue logo intro (wordmark slides out from the asterisk, 'UI' snaps into an icon), the asterisk spins in huge, breathes in and zooms through to an app tile, then a white-out reveals the browser and the camera glides into the new tab sidebar.

music.summary: No audio track in the file: pacing follows the visual build only (holds of ~1.1 s median between moves).

family_note: Restrained, single accent color, one idea at a time, clean landings, logo built on screen: Elegant core. Not Cinematic (no dark/3D light) nor Editorial (no snaps); it's the typical SaaS/app 'product UI' launch look, proposed as sub-style 'Product UI'. Cuts part of energy (6.9) is inflated by flashes/white-outs counted as cuts; real hard cuts are ~2.

behaviors.mechanism: asterisk mark enters oversized (bigger than frame) and spins ~60° while shrinking to rest with motion blur, over a white plate
behaviors.notes: sqrt(blue area) f190–f225 @60, 557→334, 22% of change in the first frame; rmse 0.012. Fitted bezier y>1 is a fit artefact of the very fast start, not an overshoot (none measured).

behaviors.mechanism: after a short hold the mark shrinks a further ~19% (anticipation, 10 f) then scales up past camera (zoom-through) revealing a blue gradient with the small app tile
behaviors.notes: Anticipation f226–f236 (334→270, bez 0.41,0.13,0.39,1.08 ≈ Cruise 0.042); zoom f236–f250 (270→816, accelerating, measured until the mark fills the frame).

behaviors.mechanism: asterisk slides left and 'Helium' wordmark is revealed from behind it (mark first, wordmark second)
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet a_ (f78–f84 @60). Same cross-family pattern as ref01/ref03/ref05.

behaviors.mechanism: 'UI' letters fade up, then snap together into a filled rounded box icon (U and I merge), flip back to letters once, then settle as the icon while 'Update' slides in from the right and tucks next to it
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets a_/b_ (f96–f150 @60). Lockup moves up by ~10 px as 'Update' arrives.

behaviors.mechanism: grey asterisk glows on black, then brand blue light rises from the bottom edge and floods the frame, turning the mark white
blue gradient bleaches to white (flash/white-out ~0.4 s), then the white browser window is revealed as the camera pulls back and the blue gradient returns around it

2.5D camera tilts/dollies from the whole window down onto the address bar, then pans left to the new vertical tab sidebar, which assembles (traffic lights, search, New Tab rows) and finally lifts as a floating card
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets e_/f_ (f432–f680 @60); slow, ease-in-out feel, low optical flow (energy plot).
